## Community game

- **Game:**
- **Parts and where each comes from** (and why that source is trustworthy):
- **Tested on:** <!-- device and SteamOS version, or "not tested on a device" -->

- [ ] Sizes and checksums pinned (and where the checksums came from)
- [ ] `art.sgdb_id` is this game on SteamGridDB
- [ ] `revision` bumped (changes to an existing game)
- [ ] `node scripts/community.mjs --check` passes and `community/index.json` is committed
- [ ] The script only writes inside the game's folder and is safe to run again
